activity.notes: Yeon Gaesomun seized political power in Goguryeo in the 642 coup and exercised dominant de facto authority as Dae Magniji until his death in 666. ATLAS models this as de facto rule rather than sovereign kingship.

sources.title: 대막리지
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture describes Dae Magniji as the supreme Goguryeo office first held by Yeon Gaesomun and associated with his concentration of military and state power.

sources.title: 삼국통일
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture describes Yeon Gaesomun's 642 coup and seizure of power in Goguryeo.
